WITH ZZ AS ( SELECT TO_DATE(#{START_DATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS START_DATE , TO_DATE(#{END_DATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')+1 AS END_DATE , #{INST_NO} AS INST_NO , #{gbIdnt} AS GB_IDNT , #{gbName} AS GB_NAME , C##RG.ENC_B64(#{name}) AS NAME , #{id} AS ID FROM DUAL ) SELECT /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.mngr.cscghvrtrkng.mapper.ConsttGhvrTrkngMapper.selectConsttGhvrTrkngList : 상담자행동추적 LIST */ DISTINCT BB.USER_ID , C##RG.DEC_B64(BB.FLNM) AS FLNM , BB.REG_DT , LISTAGG(BB.TNAME,' - ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY BB.REG_DT, BB.USER_ID, BB.TTIME) OVER(PARTITION BY BB.REG_DT, BB.USER_ID) AS CN , COUNT(*) OVER() AS TOTAL_COUNT FROM ( SELECT TO_CHAR(AA.BGNG_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS REG_DT , AA.CNSLTNT_ID AS USER_ID , AA.BGNG_DT AS TTIME , '[채팅방개설('||TO_CHAR(AA.BGNG_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD AM HH:MI:SS')||')]' AS TNAME , DD.FLNM_ENCPT AS FLNM FROM ZZ , AYB240 AA /* 심플_로그_룸 */ , SAA200 CC /* 사용자 */ , SCA100 DD /* 종사자 */ WHERE 1=1
AND AA.BGNG_DT >= ZZ.START_DATE AND AA.BGNG_DT < ZZ.END_DATE
AND CC.USER_ID = AA.CNSLTNT_ID AND CC.ENFSN_NO = DD.ENFSN_NO(+) /* 종사자번호 */ AND DD.DEL_YN = 'N' /* 종사자 삭제여부 */
AND DD.OGDP_DEPT_CD = #{DEPT_CD}
AND AA.CNSLTNT_ID LIKE '%' || ZZ.ID || '%'
AND DD.FLNM_ENCPT = ZZ.NAME
AND (AA.CNSLTNT_ID LIKE '%' || ZZ.ID || '%' OR DD.FLNM_ENCPT = ZZ.NAME )
UNION ALL SELECT TO_CHAR(AA.CHTT_BGNG_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS REG_DT , AA.CNSLTNT_ID AS USER_ID , AA.CHTT_BGNG_DT AS TTIME , '[채팅시작('||TO_CHAR(AA.CHTT_BGNG_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD AM HH:MI:SS')||')]' AS TNAME , DD.FLNM_ENCPT AS FLNM FROM ZZ , AYB200 AA /* 채팅이력 */ , SAA200 CC /* 사용자 */ , SCA100 DD /* 종사자 */ WHERE 1=1
AND AA.CHTT_BGNG_DT >= ZZ.START_DATE AND AA.CHTT_BGNG_DT < ZZ.END_DATE
AND CC.USER_ID = AA.CNSLTNT_ID AND CC.ENFSN_NO = DD.ENFSN_NO(+) /* 종사자번호 */ AND DD.DEL_YN = 'N' /* 종사자 삭제여부 */
AND DD.OGDP_DEPT_CD = #{DEPT_CD}
AND AA.CNSLTNT_ID LIKE '%' || ZZ.ID || '%'
AND DD.FLNM_ENCPT = ZZ.NAME
AND (AA.CNSLTNT_ID LIKE '%' || ZZ.ID || '%' OR DD.FLNM_ENCPT = ZZ.NAME )
UNION ALL SELECT TO_CHAR(AA.CHTT_END_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS REG_DT , AA.CNSLTNT_ID AS USER_ID , AA.CHTT_END_DT AS TTIME , '[채팅종료('||TO_CHAR(AA.CHTT_END_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD AM HH:MI:SS')||')]' AS TNAME , DD.FLNM_ENCPT AS FLNM FROM ZZ , AYB200 AA /* 채팅이력 */ , SAA200 CC /* 사용자 */ , SCA100 DD /* 종사자 */ WHERE 1=1
AND AA.CHTT_END_DT >= ZZ.START_DATE AND AA.CHTT_END_DT < ZZ.END_DATE
AND CC.USER_ID = AA.CNSLTNT_ID AND CC.ENFSN_NO = DD.ENFSN_NO(+) /* 종사자번호 */ AND DD.DEL_YN = 'N' /* 종사자 삭제여부 */
AND DD.OGDP_DEPT_CD = #{DEPT_CD}
AND AA.CNSLTNT_ID LIKE '%' || ZZ.ID || '%'
AND DD.FLNM_ENCPT = ZZ.NAME
AND (AA.CNSLTNT_ID LIKE '%' || ZZ.ID || '%' OR DD.FLNM_ENCPT = ZZ.NAME )
UNION ALL SELECT TO_CHAR(AA.FRST_REG_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS REG_DT , AA.FRST_RGTR_ID AS USER_ID , AA.FRST_REG_DT AS TTIME , '[상담원로그인('||TO_CHAR(AA.FRST_REG_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD AM HH:MI:SS')||')]' AS TNAME , DD.FLNM_ENCPT AS FLNM FROM ZZ , SAB930 AA /* 접속로그 */ , SAA200 CC /* 사용자 */ , SCA100 DD /* 종사자 */ WHERE 1=1
AND AA.FRST_REG_DT >= ZZ.START_DATE AND AA.FRST_REG_DT < ZZ.END_DATE
AND AA.LGN_LGT_SE_CD = 'I' AND CC.USER_ID = AA.FRST_RGTR_ID AND CC.ENFSN_NO = DD.ENFSN_NO(+) /* 종사자번호 */ AND DD.DEL_YN = 'N' /* 종사자 삭제여부 */
AND DD.OGDP_DEPT_CD = #{DEPT_CD}
AND AA.FRST_RGTR_ID LIKE '%' || ZZ.ID || '%'
AND DD.FLNM_ENCPT = ZZ.NAME
AND (AA.FRST_RGTR_ID LIKE '%' || ZZ.ID || '%' OR DD.FLNM_ENCPT = ZZ.NAME )
UNION ALL SELECT TO_CHAR(AA.FRST_REG_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS REG_DT , AA.FRST_RGTR_ID AS USER_ID , AA.FRST_REG_DT AS TTIME , '[상담원로그아웃('||TO_CHAR(AA.FRST_REG_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD AM HH:MI:SS')||')]' AS TNAME , DD.FLNM_ENCPT AS FLNM FROM ZZ , SAB930 AA /* 접속로그 */ , SAA200 CC /* 사용자 */ , SCA100 DD /* 종사자 */ WHERE 1=1
AND AA.FRST_REG_DT >= ZZ.START_DATE AND AA.FRST_REG_DT < ZZ.END_DATE
AND AA.LGN_LGT_SE_CD = 'O' AND CC.USER_ID = AA.FRST_RGTR_ID AND CC.ENFSN_NO = DD.ENFSN_NO(+) /* 종사자번호 */ AND DD.DEL_YN = 'N' /* 종사자 삭제여부 */
AND DD.OGDP_DEPT_CD = #{DEPT_CD}
AND AA.FRST_RGTR_ID LIKE '%' || ZZ.ID || '%'
AND DD.FLNM_ENCPT = ZZ.NAME
AND (AA.FRST_RGTR_ID LIKE '%' || ZZ.ID || '%' OR DD.FLNM_ENCPT = ZZ.NAME )
) BB WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY BB.REG_DT , BB.USER_ID
